system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or higher. The target gains a +[POW mod] bonus to [Physical Defense] and [Magical Defense]. This effect lasts until the beginning of your next Main Process, or until the target leaves the square you are in.

(SR2): Increase bonus to +[[POW mod] + 4].
(SR3): Increase bonus to +[[POW mod] + 8].

Magic that creates a sanctuary that wards off disasters and protects nearby allies. No matter what kind of hostility swirls on the battlefield, the sanctuary becomes a haven.
